'''Sonic amplifier''' was a device for amplyfying the volume of the sounds. [[Gault Rennow]] threatened to use a Sonic amplifier on [[Dretcher]]'s hideout container, making the tones of [[Kashyyyk Life Day Choir]] so loud, they'd shake him to death.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sonic amplifier appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' "Chapter 13: Profit and Plunder".
